speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Migraine with aura. The combination of scintillating scotomas (flashing lights), transient visual field defects (blur in the corner of the eye), and a headache that often peaks or is noticed in the morning is highly characteristic of migraine with aura, especially given the trigger of computer use.
